brief: Holds an agent that perceives its memory, decides under governance, acts through verified skills and can say why.
detail: A stzPIAgent is assembled from parts that already exist: a stzAgentMemory over a knowledge graph, stzAgentSkill objects (precondition, action, check) and a stzGovernance record. Cycle runs one pass over the skills: a skill whose precondition does not hold is skipped, a governed skill asks MayProceed first and is refused if it does not pass, and an admitted skill is applied and verified. Pursue repeats Cycle to a fixpoint, bounded at 20 rounds. It is deterministic and offline. GiveWorkbench binds the safe world: the agent's ring functions then rehearse file writes in memory, and GenerateUpdatePlan is the one export toward reality.
receiver:
o1 = new stzPIAgent("kitchen-bot")
o2 = new stzAgentSkill("restock")
